Graphic3d aspects mapping (visualization-design.md section 1): Graphic3d_Aspects is the trait Graphic3dAspectsSource (virtual DumpJson) over Graphic3dAspectsBase, whose protected fields are the public Graphic3dAspectsFields behind the handle's shared lock; the non-virtual members are the blanket traits Graphic3dAspectsMembers, Graphic3dAspectsRenderMembers, Graphic3dAspectsLineMembers, Graphic3dAspectsTextMembers, Graphic3dAspectsEdgeMembers and Graphic3dAspectsEqual; range checks return Standard_OutOfRange with the offending value; the dump text and the class defaults are compared by the sv_aspects_dump native probe. Font_FontMgr mapping: the process-wide registry with the X11 (fontconfig) build of InitFontDataBase: fontconfig (loaded at run time) or the X font server configuration give the font directories, then the default directories, scanned recursively in the native NCollection_Map order, with fonts.dir entries and their XLFD aliases; the alias table of the X11 branch; aliases share their sequences as natively (AddFontAlias keeps the quirk of comparing entries with the alias name); the embedded DejaVu Sans Latin WOFF (with its Bitstream Vera license) is the fallback font. The database, aliases, FindFont over names, strict levels and aspects and FindFallbackFont are compared by the sv_fontmgr native probe; the GoogleTest suite Font_FontMgr_Test is translated.
